text: Want to buy something you don't really need? Try the one-to-one rule first. For every luxury purchase, buy an asset too. New handbag, add to your investment. New gadget, add to your SIPs. New jewelry, add to your Gold ETF. Treat your future self too, not just your present self. And don't forget to tag that one friend who you think should really watch this reel. Follow investing for mummies and join our workshops for more such tips.
